# Active Permanent

> > Tech tutorials and troubleshooting guides for Windows, Android, iOS, and popular software applications.

Active Permanent provides practical how-to guides, security advice, and troubleshooting solutions for consumer technology. The site covers Windows operating systems (7/8/10/11), mobile platforms (Android, iOS), popular apps (Gmail, Deezer, WebEx), smart home devices (Ring, August), and multimedia tools like Format Factory.

## Key Topics

- Windows 10/11 troubleshooting
- Android mobile tutorials
- iOS and iPhone guides
- Security and cybersecurity
- Format Factory media converter
- Gmail and email management
- Smart home device setup
- VPN and privacy tools
- Windows error fixes
- Dark mode and display settings
- Multimedia conversion tools
- Password security
- Chrome OS support
- Mobile app configuration
